prompts.compass: Create ONE new compass rose illustration asset for The Long Road, matching the copperplate engraving, sepia ink and warm restrained hand tint of reference image (the lute is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY). Circular antique cartographer's compass viewed flat face-on. Extremely intricate 32-point mariner's wind rose, eight long sharp alternating ivory and faded vermilion points, precise nested engraved rings, little fleur-de-lis at north, stippled and crosshatched cartouches and curling acanthus only in the outer spandrels, minute engraved divisions, fine double rule concentric borders. It must read strongly at widget size: boldly dark main points, fine internal detail, balanced octagonal outer silhouette. Print illustration not a rendered object, no glossy brass, no shadows, no photorealism, no plastic. No text except tiny N E S W in antique serif positions. Entire ornamental compass fits in square with 7 percent clear border. TRUE TRANSPARENT background around the ink/ivory printed compass. This will replace a weak simple geometric compass.
prompts.expedition: Create an original sprite contact sheet for The Long Road Expedition idle-game widget. Reference is STYLE ONLY: match its dense antique copperplate/woodcut travel-book engraving, intricate line hatching, warm cream parchment, sepia and charcoal ink, muted red/ochre clothing, landscape hand tints. EXACTLY 8 equal landscape panels arranged TWO COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, precisely aligned edge to edge in a portrait sheet with thin even cream gutters. Each panel roughly 2.4:1. Each row is one recognizable anonymous adult traveler, same clothes and pack in both panels. Left column WALKING, right column CAMPING. No words or typography. Four traveler identities: row1 long vermilion hooded cloak with leather roll-pack; row2 broad russet hat and olive shoulder cape with rectangular satchel; row3 ochre rain mantle and walking staff with round wicker pack; row4 slate-blue hood and patched short cloak with tied blanket. Show adult proportions, heads small with faces turned away, literary engraved story illustrations. Not cartoons, not game sprites or vector figures. Each left scene: full person prominent in left-middle foreground on an intricately drawn road, countryside, tree roots, stone waymarkers, distant village/bridge/ridge; walking toward right, pack and staff visible. Each matching right scene: same traveler seated by a small warming fire under a canvas lean-to, pack and staff beside them, detailed roots, dry-stone wall, rolled blankets and distant road; rest not sleep, calm understated humor. Different countryside compositions each row: wooded footbridge; ruined arch and marsh path; high pasture with stone wall; coastal road with cliff and tower. Avoid real place names and copyrighted imagery. Edge-to-edge pictorial detail within each panel, designed to remain readable cropped inside a small horizontal journal plate. All eight scenes fully rendered, no empty half-panels, no repeated generic silhouettes. Keep one main traveler per panel. No animal companions because those will be represented by saved-game labels. Matte printed ink and fine etched lines, never photorealistic painting.
